claim_limit: This protocol is not a blind validation. The later User-1 target period has been inspected while correcting the production mapper and is now a post-hoc diagnostic, not an untouched validation.

coheating_allocation.purpose: allocate the independently published 107 W/K whole-house heat-transfer coefficient to the four official air bodies

user1_calibration.purpose: fit only the effective thermal capacity after sensitivity screening

user1_temporal_transfer.purpose: untouched temporal transfer; no parameter, preprocessing, or threshold changes permitted

fixed_inputs.envelope_allocation: The published 107 W/K whole-house HTC is distributed in proportion to per-air-body median heat-input/temperature-difference ratios during low-solar near-steady coheat intervals.

amendment_rule: Thresholds remain recorded for forensic comparison. No result from the inspected later period may be promoted to blind, holdout, or untouched validation evidence.
